page.layout: One page of running text in a single block. Marginal notes on both the left and right edges, cut off by the scan edge and not reliably legible. Running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: torpeatque fuperba Corinthii lingua, problemata de torpedine iactitans. Marinos aiût piscatores, fi quando torpedo reti capta fit, manus afflici,nifi (ta-tim rete deuinciant a pertica. Quomodo vero,o a-mice, per lignum piscatores lædit hoc animal? ANT. In mare miraculorum linguam, quemadmodum Pericles, mouifti. intra cognitionis terminos men-tem tuam cohibe, qui quasi Atlanticum contem-plationum pelagus tibi vis narrari. Ego autem tuo Polycrates in hoc amori breuiter obsequar. POL. Dicas igitur, o generosé. Urbani enim videntur mi-hi & unles hi fermones, qui proponantur. Non a te recedam hodie, non per optimum hunc meum ambrem. ANT. Iucundissima forte aeris est natura, refona, fuda, odorata. quæ omnia in aere diuinæ quædam curæ optime procurarunt, ut illius ita o-pera recrearetur ac reficeretur isthæc terræ regio. multarum igitur passionum effectuumq; caufator hic est. Quod enim qui laborant ex oculis, in eos qui in se intuentur, morbi sæpe partem transfun-dunt, per aerem certe fit circumstantem interstitii infar, unde valetudo nobis & inualetudo. Itaque per medium aerem torpedo quoque vitium potest inferre nō procul abstientib. etiamsi non tangatur. Dabo vero tibi etiam huius exemplum. Magnes, quem Heracleum quoque lapidem vocant, a ferro distat, nihilominus per medium aerem videmus o-perari lapidem in ferrum. Jam vero communis illa affectio, in palma arbore, cuius mentem non per-cellat? cuius auditum non obstupuit? Diuerfus primo sexus est, discretaque femina. deinde vicinis inter se mafculo exiftentibus & femina videas utiq; femi-

page.notes: Right and left margin notes are cut off at the scan edge and could not be read; they are not transcribed. The first word of the running head is doubtful ([?]). The main text is set as one paragraph, as no clear indents are visible. Several words are read with some doubt, for example "ambrem", "afflici,nifi", "infar" and "mafculo"; they are copied as seen and not marked further. The catchword "femi-" is printed at the lower right, below the last line.
